ui_bugs.issue: After successful site creation via ns-save, toast 'Cantiere creato' fires and onCreated calls setSiteId(site.id), but the nq-site Radix Select trigger still shows placeholder 'Seleziona cantiere…' and nq-submit remains disabled — the newly created cantiere is NOT auto-selected as required by the spec. Sites list refetch invalidateQueries is fired but the SelectItem for the new site is not yet present when setSiteId runs, so Radix Select can't display it. Workaround: user must manually click nq-site and pick the new cantiere. Repro: /quotes → Nuovo preventivo → pick customer → + Nuovo cantiere → fill all fields incl. phone → Crea cantiere → observe nq-site trigger unchanged.

issues: Profilatura ml quantity displayed with English decimal dot ('5.40 ml', '5.80 ml') instead of Italian format ('5,40 ml' / '5,80 ml'). Amounts are already localized (43,20 € / 92,80 €). Minor cosmetic inconsistency.

action_items: Fix nq-site auto-selection after site creation: after site is created and returned, either (a) await refetch of sites-for-quote before setSiteId, or (b) insert the returned site into the local query cache with setQueryData so Radix Select renders the SelectItem immediately when siteId is set.
critical_code_review_comments: QuotesPage.jsx onCreated does invalidateQueries + setSiteId(site.id) in the same tick — Radix Select won't reflect a value that isn't present in its SelectItem children, so trigger displays placeholder until refetch completes; consider qc.setQueryData(['sites-for-quote', customerId], (old) => ({...old, items: [site, ...(old?.items||[])]})) then setSiteId(site.id).
InstallationModeCard: Smaltimento select has disableIncluded=true (fail-closed) as required. Smontaggio 30€/pz correctly resolved by service_resolver — no 40€ leak. Good.

MultiCategoryConfiguratorDialog edit mode reliably prefills width/height/qty/glass and reopens at step 3 for FINESTRE/CASSONETTO/PERSIANA. reconfigure endpoint returns same lineId and services recompute authoritatively (verified rows count stayed constant across edits).

Line services rendering uses locale-aware currency (€) but ml value (Profilatura X.YZ ml) uses default JS toString — should route through Number.toLocaleString('it-IT', {minimumFractionDigits:2}) for consistency.

rca of the issue: nq-site auto-selection bug — In /app/frontend/src/pages/QuotesPage.jsx (line 216): `onCreated={(site) => { qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['sites-for-quote', customerId] }); setSiteId(site.id); setShowNewSite(false); }}`. React-Query invalidate triggers async refetch; setSiteId runs synchronously with a value that isn't yet present in `(sites?.items || [])` used at line 198 to render SelectItem children. Radix Select requires the value to match an existing SelectItem to display it. Fix: prepend the newly-created site to the cache before setSiteId: `qc.setQueryData(['sites-for-quote', customerId], (old) => ({ ...(old||{}), items: [site, ...((old&&old.items)||[])] }))` then `setSiteId(site.id)`.
